a.xlink:title: Generates a QR code from current input fields and visual settings, then saves it via GenerateAndSaveS...
Generates and saves a QR code as a PNG file using the provided data and configuration.
Collects current input and visual settings into a WholeFields for QR code generation.
Validates and returns the current QR code margin from the margin slider.
Validates and returns the current image-to-QR ratio from the ratio slider.
Validates and returns the QR code size from the corresponding text field.
Validates that all required inputs are non-null.
Opens a JFileChooser to select the output PNG file and handles file name conflicts.
Executes QR code generation asynchronously using a SwingWorker.
Ensures the selected file has a ".png" extension.
Resolves potential file name conflicts by checking if the specified file already exists.
Creates a new QR generation worker.
Clears input fields corresponding to the active generation mode upon exceeding capacity limits.
Validates and returns the current meet UID from the meet title field.
